html:
SMTO-MEM-0044 — Knowledge needs to be repaired after a change

GUID: 7925bf2b-34c9-5c97-9a10-6565225e9fb0
Slug: knowledge-installation-verification-required
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • SMTO checked the Knowledge parts installed on the server and found they don't fully match this version of SMTO, often after an update. Knowledge may not work until the installation is repaired.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On System Health, select Copy error details for the Knowledge check and send them to the person who manages SMTO. The details show which part of the Knowledge installation didn't match.
  2. Ask them to run the Knowledge installation repair on the server, especially if SMTO was recently updated. An update can change what Knowledge needs, and only the repair on the server brings the installed parts in line.
  3. After they finish, select Check Knowledge on System Health again. This confirms the installation now matches this version of SMTO.

What success looks like

  • Check Knowledge passes and the Knowledge page shows Ready.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO, and mention any recent SMTO update. Don't delete Knowledge documents or the data folder; your documents are kept through the repair.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • System Health could not verify the Knowledge installation: setup.json is not in the ready state or its fingerprint does not match the running SMTO's pinned Knowledge dependencies and installer, or a required file (installation.json, OCR configuration, model list, vector database or Python environment) is missing.

What this means

  • The saved installation receipt does not verify all assets required by the running Knowledge code. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported installation_verification_required. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The installed dependency and model receipt matches the running software.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Stop the server with its normal launcher, run python -m agent_runtime.rag.install in the application's Python environment with the same state-directory configuration (use --root only for the existing installation/rag directory), start the server, and run Check Knowledge on System Health. The installer may download dependencies and models; the UI does not run it.
  • Ask the server administrator to run the supported Knowledge installation repair, then check Knowledge status again.
  • Administrator: stop the controller using its normal launcher. With the application's Python environment and the same state-directory configuration, run python -m agent_runtime.rag.install, then start the controller again and run Check Knowledge. Use --root PATH only for the existing installation/rag directory. This installer may download dependencies and models; the UI does not run it automatically.

Retry and execution caution

  • The installed dependency and model receipt matches the running software.

How to verify the fix

  • The installed dependency and model receipt matches the running software.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
